wholePhysicalScope: The named Tehran mosque relation 17091736 contains a 14-point exterior and four-point courtyard. The basin is separately mapped. The northern bazaar stair trace is retained as orientation evidence.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the four iwans, rectangular basin, south dome, and northern clock and two minarets. Near levels add tile borders, recessed bays, canopy columns and dome ribs.
limitations: The outer boundary, court and basin follow native mapping. Portal and minaret heights, north clock housing, reconstructed roof levels, dome profile and tile colors are estimated from period and written evidence.
The model covers the visible mosque. The neighboring bazaar, remote approach stairs, canopies and full interiors are outside the modeled scope.
